correctness.summary: Starting from the explicit Lee--Wang parametrization, canonical scaling gives the stated conformal metric. The curvature identity, exact total-curvature integral, radial coordinate, and ball-area formula follow by direct calculation. Differentiation of the exact area ratio reduces the unique maximum to monotonicity of a sinh(2a), and the density crossing to a strictly increasing scalar function. The Möbius quotient halves cylinder area and curvature; the metric lower bound gives the sharp 2pi systole with rigid equality.

originality.scope: to the best of our knowledge
originality.summary: Lee--Wang provide the shrinker family, metric/area form, and conical asymptotics, while Braxton--Lee--Zhu prove F-stability of the (2,1) Möbius quotient and compute its Gaussian entropy. Searches and inspection of the principal related sources did not locate the exact Gaussian/total curvature package, centered Euclidean ball-area profile, unique overshoot/crossing law, logarithmic area excess, or Möbius systole stated here. A forthcoming Braxton thesis on the same surface was not available for inspection and is the most specific residual coverage risk.

value.summary: The result gives exact global intrinsic and extrinsic invariants for a newly established stable higher-codimension shrinker and extends the area-growth mechanism to the whole Lee--Wang family. The single finite-radius overshoot and positive logarithmic excess sharpen the qualitative statement of conical asymptotics, while the total-curvature and systolic identities add complementary global geometry.

limitations: For general (p,q), area is the parameterized immersed area and counts multiplicity.
The result does not establish nonlinear stability, compact-flow realization, or F-stability of the other Lee--Wang shrinkers.
Centered Euclidean area growth is distinct from the Gaussian F-functional and entropy.
The forthcoming Braxton thesis on the same Möbius shrinker was not available for inspection.
Independent audit has not been performed.
